title: Remove Users (via Bluesky List)
description: Exclude posts from users in a Bluesky list
notes:
✓ Easy to manage users via Bluesky UI
✓ List is public (visible to others)
✗ Requires maintaining a Bluesky list

title: Remove Users (Direct DIDs)
description: Exclude posts from specific users by their DIDs
notes:
✓ Private (not visible if feed logic is private)
✓ Persists after handle changes
✗ Must manually manage DID list

Find user DIDs from their profile URL or use a DID resolver.

title: Remove Users (Social Graph)
description: Exclude posts from users followed by or following a specific account
notes:
✓ Dynamic - updates as the user's follows/followers change
✓ Useful for excluding entire communities

Options:
• not_in + follows = exclude users that user.bsky.social follows
• not_in + followers = exclude users that follow user.bsky.social
• in + follows = include only users that user.bsky.social follows
• in + followers = include only users that follow user.bsky.social
